200.description: One page of the matching assignments.

destinationPostalPrefix.description: The postal prefix of the destination (from CustomerOrderPlaced); never an address.

witnessNodeId.description: The node of the promise's witness path; the assigned node may differ.

revisionNo.description: The promise revision applied (0 until delivery-promise revises it, gap G13). Node exclusions reset when it changes.

listingId.description: The listing of the released node; absent while QUEUED.

pickupCutoffAt.description: The pickup departure's cutoff at this node; the requiredShipBy of a release.

legs.description: Departure ids after the pickup, in travel order.

candidate.description: The current best candidate; absent when none meets deliverByLatest (UNSOURCEABLE) or the assignment is CANCELLED.

releaseAt.description: VirtualQueue release point (best candidate's pickup cutoff - node handling time - vendor ack budget); present while QUEUED.

reasonCode.description: Present when the node rejected (the vendor's reason code).

pickupDepartureId.description: The pickup departure of the locked path; follows BookingMoved.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

400.description: invalid-limit (limit is not an integer in 1..500), invalid-cursor (the cursor does not decode) or unknown-query-parameter (any query parameter other than state, nodeId, orderId, limit, cursor).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example assignment-locked.

422.description: validation-failed (ErrValidation), an invalid state query parameter.
